title: Celly Organa
description: Duchess Celly Organa was a member of the House of Organa and sister to the Queen, Breha Organa. She and her husband, Kayo Organa, visited the Royal Family just before the incident where her niece, Leia, was kidnapped. Her son, Niano, had a quarrel with Leia shortly before she was abducted by Vect Nokru.
